description: This Java class CityFinder provides utility methods to set geographic coordinates and retrieve city name from location data using Android's Geocoder.

classes.name: CityFinder
classes.description: A utility class for handling location-based operations such as setting coordinates and fetching city names.

methods.name: setLongitudeLatitude
methods.description: Sets the latitude and longitude in the static LocationCord class based on a given Location object.

methods.name: getCityNameUsingNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves the city name from a Location object using Android's Geocoder, with fallback error handling.
